Work in /work to implement the supplied repository task.
Reply with exactly one operation object in this envelope:
{"operation":{"action":"shell","command":"..."}},
{"operation":{"action":"test"}}, or {"operation":{"action":"done"}}.
Shell commands can read and edit repository files. The test action runs the
supplied test command. Tests are read-only. Network access is unavailable.
You have at most eight responses. Do not infer success from missing output
or incomplete test execution.
